notes: Sua LICH DANG cho dung: 'Dang luon' thi page lam xong dau tien dang NGAY, page sau gian dung so phut da cai, bai lan 2 tinh tu lan 1 cua chinh page do (truoc bi don chung mot gio = dang lien tuc). Chan chay bua: page chua gan link nguon / chua cao thi khong chay + bao ro ly do. Bo gioi han so luong chay song song (dat 0 = chay het). Dong bo Google Sheet TU THEM DONG cho page moi; dan link nguon va link Sheet TU LUU. Bai dang ANH chay song song nhu video, theo doi song o man hinh chinh, co hashtag, chu tu sang len khi nen toi, chu de do Gemini lay tu chinh video cua page va khong lap lai. Cao nguon: chan reel la cua khung thong bao lot vao danh sach page. Giao dien: thu gon 2 bang lich, chon tat ca, hien du id reel, khong con nhay len dau trang khi sua cau hinh. Cong don 23 file.
